Try finding your >x< account with one verifying piece of information like your username to help determine the email or phone associated with your account.
Start with your username

Entering a valid username prompts >x< to ask for the email address associated with your account. Try any possible email address you may have associated with your account. When you provide the valid email, >x< will ask how you want to reset your password.
Start with your phone number

If you can’t determine the valid email, repeat the process above with possible phone numbers. When you provide the valid phone number, >x< sends a code to the phone associated with your account so you can reset your password. If you receive a prompt saying more than one >x< account is associated with a phone number, this option won’t work for you.
